items.title: BB clears Tk 3,000cr loan for defaulted City Group firms
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank has exempted five defaulted companies of City Group from a key provision of the banking law, clearing the way for a Tk 3,000 crore working capital facility to be arranged by a syndicate of eight banks.

items.title: Banks’ lending income turns negative for first time in 6 years

items.title: Money changers can now open custodial forex accounts
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank has allowed licensed money changers to open foreign currency custodial accounts to ensure the safe handling of cash foreign currencies and reduce risks associated with their transportation.

items.title: BB sells another $100m to stabilise forex market
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank yesterday sold another $100 million from its foreign exchange reserves through an auction, aiming to stabilise the currency market amid rising import costs, particularly for fuel.

items.title: Economic gloom takes the shine off furniture industry
items.description: Furniture sales have fallen by up to 30 percent from their pre-Covid peak, according to manufacturers, as years of stubbornly high inflation leave households with little money for non-essentials.
